## Net income.
Table on document page 42 is "Consolidated Statements of Operations." Numbers are in thousands except per share data. The row for net income under the 2023 column says $251,400 thousand.

## Interest income, net.
Page 42, same table. "Interest income, net" row, 2023 column: $13,687 thousand.

## Tax expense from page 42.
Still page 42, same table. Income tax expense row, 2023 column: $74,792 thousand.

## D and A from page 54.
Go to page 54. Table: "Note 5 — Property, Plant and Equipment, Net." In the footnote it says depreciation expense for 2023 was $56.4 million. Amortization for 2023: $1.7 million.

## EBITDA math.
This company shows net interest income not net interest expense. So subtract it from net income to back it out. EBITDA = 251.4 minus 13.687 plus 74.792 plus 56.4 plus 1.7. That adds up to 370.605. Final answer: $370.605 million.

## Source of data.
Table name: "Boise Cascade Company Consolidated Balance Sheets." Document page: 57. Numbers reported in thousands of U.S. dollars. Balance sheet date: December 31, 2024.

## Values from page 57.
Trade receivables: $321,820 thousand. Related parties receivables: $173 thousand. Other receivables: $22,772 thousand. Receivables total: $344,765 thousand. Inventories: $803,296 thousand. Prepaid and other assets: $24,747 thousand. Property and equipment, net: $1,047,083 thousand. Operating lease right-of-use assets: $49,673 thousand. Timber deposits: $6,916 thousand. Excluded: cash, finance lease assets, goodwill, intangibles, deferred taxes.

## Answer.
Total value of operating assets as of December 31, 2024: $2,276,480 thousand, which equals $2,276.5 million.

## Location of the data.
Page 53 of the 10-K. Management's Discussion and Analysis section has a table that reconciles net income to EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023, and 2022. Numbers are in thousands.

## 2024 column values.
Net income: 376,354 thousand. Interest expense: 24,067 thousand. Interest income: (39,139) thousand. Income tax provision: 125,405 thousand. Depreciation and amortization: 144,113 thousand.

## The answer.
Boise Cascade Corporation EBITDA for year ended December 31, 2024 is $630,800 thousand.

## Table location.
Page 105. The table is named "BINAH CAPITAL GROUP INC. CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF CHANGES IN MEMBERS' EQUITY FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023 AND 2022 (in thousands)."

## Reported net income for 2023.
The table shows net income of 571 (thousands).

## Scenario: net income is 1,200.
Difference from actual: 1,200 minus 571 = 629 (thousands).

## Impact on accumulated deficit.
2023 year-end accumulated deficit: minus 18,690. An extra 629 of net income reduces the deficit. New deficit: minus 18,690 plus 629 = minus 18,061.

## Total members' equity under the scenario.
Capital is 8,886. Common Amount is 12,299. Class B Preferred is 2,609. Accumulated Deficit is minus 18,061. Sum: 8,886 + 12,299 + 2,609 - 18,061 = 5,733.

## Source.
Document page 157. Look up the table under "BIOGEN INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS — (Continued)" and find "Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities."

## Numbers.
2015 total deferred tax assets: 871.7 (in millions). 2015 total deferred tax liabilities: 542.8 (in millions).

## The answer.
Biogen's net deferred tax asset balance as of December 31, 2015 is $328.9 million.

## Table on page 83.
Page 83 shows "NEW PROVIDENCE ACQUISITION CORP. BALANCE SHEET DECEMBER 31, 2019." Values are raw dollar amounts.

## Prepaid expenses amount.
The "Prepaid expenses" line shows $131,226.

## Applying the 15.15% increase.
$131,226 times 1.1515 equals $151,106.74.

## The increase amount.
$151,106.74 minus $131,226 equals $19,880.74.

## Total assets from the balance sheet.
"Total Assets" on page 83: $231,839,185.

## Updated total assets.
$231,839,185 plus $19,880.74 equals $231,859,065.74.

## Operating cash outflow.
Page 78, "Statements of Cash Flows." Row "Net cash used in operating activities": $24,752 (in thousands).

## Year-end cash.
Page 75, "Balance Sheets." Subheading: "(In thousands, except share and per share amounts)." Row "Cash and cash equivalents" at December 31, 2019: $8,377 thousand.

## Monthly burn rate.
24,752 divided by 12 months = 2,062.7 per month.

## Runway.
8,377 divided by 2,062.7 = 4.06 months. Viking Therapeutics had 4.06 months of runway as of December 31, 2019.

## Source data.
Page 68, table: "Cost of Revenue, Gross Profit, and Gross Margin." Year ended January 28, 2023. Values in thousands except percentages. Cost of revenue: $182,656 thousand, or $182.7M. The text below the table cites $9.1M increase from infrastructure costs and $27.6M increase from amortization of deferred IoT device costs.

## Infrastructure delta.
Scenario: 50% more than the reported $9.1M increase. 9.1 times 1.50 = 13.65. Extra amount: 13.65 - 9.1 = 4.55.

## Amortization delta.
Scenario: 10% more than the reported $27.6M increase. 27.6 times 1.10 = 30.36. Extra amount: 30.36 - 27.6 = 2.76.

## New total cost of revenue.
182.7 + 4.55 + 2.76 + 3.5 = 193.51. Total adjusted cost of revenue: $193.51 million.

## Cash flow statement data.
Page 65, "Norfolk Southern Corporation and Subsidiaries Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows" table. Years ended December 31, 2021. All amounts in millions. Net cash provided by operating activities: $4,255 million. Depreciation: $1,181 million. Net income from page 61: $3,005 million.

## Adjusting net income.
The scenario reduces net income by $250 million.

## Adjusting depreciation.
Depreciation increases by 10% of $1,181 million. 1,181 times 0.10 = $118.1 million more. Since depreciation is a non-cash add-back, higher depreciation increases operating cash flow.

## Net impact on operating cash flow.
Net income down $250M, depreciation up $118.1M. Net change: minus 250 plus 118.1 equals minus 131.9 million.

## Revised operating cash flow.
4,255 minus 131.9 equals $4,123.1 million.

## Source.
Page 73, Note 3, "Purchase Price Allocation and Goodwill." December 2023 acquisitions only (not January 2024).

## Values.
Fat Shark: $14,000,000 purchase price; $4,293,204 net assets. Rotor Riot: $6,000,000 purchase price; $1,047,059 net assets.

## Percentages.
Fat Shark net assets / purchase price = 30.66%. Rotor Riot net assets / purchase price = 17.45%.

## Segment sales table.
Page 30 has "Reporting Segment Net Sales." Numbers are in millions.

## Values to use.
2021 Grocery and Snacks: 4,624.7. 2022 Grocery and Snacks: 4,697.4. 2022 Total Net Sales: 11,535.9.

## Hypothetical segment revenue.
If 5% growth off 2021: 4,624.7 times 1.05 = 4,855.935.

## Hypothetical total revenue.
Remove the actual 2022 Grocery segment, add the hypothetical: 11,535.9 - 4,697.4 + 4,855.935 = 11,694.435.

## Graph on page 30.
Title: "Performance Graph." Document page: 30. Covers December 31, 2018 to December 31, 2023. Tracks Adams Resources and Energy Inc., S&P 500, and S&P Integrated Oil and Gas Index. $100 base in 2018, with dividends reinvested.

## Reading the data.
The graph has a table below it with exact values per year-end. For December 31, 2023: Adams Resources and Energy Inc. = $78.79. S&P 500 = $207.21.

## Subtraction.
207.21 minus 78.79 equals 128.42.

## Answer.
The difference in total return performance between Adams Resources and Energy Inc. and the S&P 500 at December 31, 2023 is 128.42.

## Source.
Page 22 of the document, "Consolidated Statements of Operations." Figures are in thousands. Two fiscal years: ending January 31, 2022 and January 31, 2023.

## The numbers.
Operating income 2022: 8,111. Operating income 2023: 11,144. (in thousands)

## Balance sheet location.
Page 66, "STRATA Skin Sciences, Inc. and Subsidiary Consolidated Balance Sheets." Units: in thousands, except share and per share data. Date: December 31, 2023.

## Total debt.
No current portion of long-term debt is listed under current liabilities. The only interest-bearing debt is "Long-term debt, net." Value for 2023: $15,044 thousand.

## Total stockholders' equity.
"Total Stockholders' Equity" on page 66 for December 31, 2023: $12,688 thousand.

## Values summary.
Long-term debt, net (total debt): $15,044 thousand. Total Stockholders' Equity: $12,688 thousand.

## Debt-to-equity ratio.
15,044 / 12,688 = 1.1857. Total debt is $15,044 thousand and total equity is $12,688 thousand. The debt-to-equity ratio is 1.1857.

## Source.
Pages 46-47. "Consolidated Statements of Stockholders' Equity."

## Values from the statements.
Net income for 2024: $160.2 million. Stock-based compensation expense: $37.9 million. Repurchase of common stock: $(150.7) million. Common stock dividends paid: $(56.7) million.

## Direction of each item.
Net income increases equity. Stock-based comp increases equity (it is a non-cash item). Repurchases reduce equity. Dividends paid reduce equity.

## Net change from the four components.
160.2 + 37.9 - 150.7 - 56.7 = -9.3. Change in equity from the four specified items: negative $9.3 million.
